name: Rushe Maliano
source:
[From Official Website]
She always carries a large jewel. She has a weak presence outside of Ruffin and is not well-known by people. She hates to be near water due to a past experience. She is always cheerful and smiling, but sometimes her expression can suddenly become clouded. She also has a sensitive heart and is easily hurt by small things.
